products.title: Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration - Mini Tin - Lapras
products.body_html:
Commemorate 30 years of joy with fan-favorite Pokemon spanning three dazzling decades! Celebrate this magnificent milestone with the mighty presences of Mewtwo ex and Mew ex, followed by a wealth of allies like Umbreon ex, Salamence ex, and Greninja ex. Plus, there are 30 reasons to honour Pikachu, as each booster pack contains one-with 30 unique variations to collect as Pikachu rare cards! And, whether you're looking forward to a glittering future or taking a nostalgic look at a storied past, there are a host of treasures to find and secrets to reveal in the Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration!

Pokemon Favorites in the Palm of Your Hand!
Commemorate 30 years of joy with fan-favorite Pokemon spanning three dazzling decades!

Collect all 10!

products.title: Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration - Elite Trainer Box
products.body_html:
Celebrate 30 years of Pokémon with the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration expansion! Bringing together fan-favourite Pokémon from across three decades, this special set is packed with exciting cards to discover and collect. Look out for powerful Pokémon ex, including Mewtwo ex, Mew ex, Umbreon ex, Salamence ex, and Greninja ex. Plus, every booster pack contains a Pikachu rare card, with 30 unique variations to collect, giving you plenty of reasons to catch them all! Whether you're a longtime Pokémon fan revisiting some familiar favourites or discovering the franchise for the first time, the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration expansion is filled with nostalgic treasures, sparkling surprises and plenty of secrets to uncover.

The Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box includes:

9 Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration booster packs
1 full-art promo card featuring an illustration packed with 30 Nidorina, which happens to be #0030 in the Pokédex 
16 foil Basic Energy cards
65 card sleeves
A player's guide to the 30th Celebration expansion
6 damage-counter dice
1 competition-legal coin-flip die
1 plastic coin
A collector's box to hold everything, with 6 dividers to keep it organized
A code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live
